daas-irab:1-10.t: ﴿حم وَالْكِتابِ الْمُبِينِ﴾ the i'rab of its like has already been given; ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿فِي لَيْلَةٍ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; ﴿مُبارَكَةٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿كُنَّا﴾ kāna and its noun; ﴿مُنْذِرِينَ﴾ its khabar, and the verbal clause is the khabar of إنا, and the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached to what follows them; ﴿يُفْرَقُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb; ﴿كُلُّ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿أَمْرٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿حَكِيمٍ﴾ an adjective of أمر, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿أَمْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb; ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِنا﴾ both attached to an omitted adjective of أمرا; ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar, and the verbal clause is the khabar of إنا, and the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative (manṣūb); ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ both attached to رحمة; ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿هُوَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); ﴿السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ﴾ two khabars of inna, and the nominal clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl); ﴿رَبِّ﴾ a badal (substitute) for ربك; ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات; ﴿وَما﴾ conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted verb forming the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative; ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional that makes the verb jussive; ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; ﴿مُوقِنِينَ﴾ its khabar, and the clause كنتم is initial (ibtidāʾiyya); ﴿لا﴾ negative, operating like inna; ﴿إِلهَ﴾ its noun, and its khabar is omitted; ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿هُوَ﴾ a badal for the noun of لا; ﴿يُحْيِي﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿وَيُمِيتُ﴾ conjoined to يحيي; ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾ badal; ﴿وَرَبُّ﴾ conjoined; ﴿آبائِكُمُ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ an adjective; ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb); ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿فِي شَكٍّ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar; ﴿يَلْعَبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the verbal clause is a ḥāl, and the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿فَارْتَقِبْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; ﴿تَأْتِي﴾ an imperfect verb; ﴿السَّماءُ﴾ fāʿil; ﴿بِدُخانٍ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).

daas-irab:11-18.t: ﴿يَغْشَى﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of دخان; ﴿هذا عَذابٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ an adjective of عذاب, and the nominal clause is the object of an omitted saying (maqūl qawl maḥdhūf); ﴿رَبَّنَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), in annexation; ﴿اكْشِفْ﴾ a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿عَنَّا﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause ربنا is the object of an omitted saying; ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿مُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ its khabar, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya); ﴿أَنَّى﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative (marfūʿ) as a fronted khabar; ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ both attached to an omitted second khabar; ﴿الذِّكْرى﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the object of an omitted saying; ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); ﴿جاءَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿رَسُولٌ﴾ a postponed fāʿil; ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ an adjective of رسول, and the clause is circumstantial; ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction; ﴿تَوَلَّوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿عَنْهُ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and قالوا is conjoined to تولوا; ﴿مُعَلَّمٌ﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; ﴿مَجْنُونٌ﴾ a second khabar, and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿كاشِفُوا﴾ its khabar; ﴿الْعَذابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation), and the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); ﴿إِنَّكُمْ عائِدُونَ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb; ﴿نَبْطِشُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿الْبَطْشَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿الْكُبْرى﴾ an adjective of البطشة, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿مُنْتَقِمُونَ﴾ its khabar, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive, and what is sworn by is omitted, and the lām occurs in the response to the oath (jawāb al-qasam), and قد is a particle of affirmation; ﴿فَتَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position; ﴿قَبْلَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of time; ﴿قَوْمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿وَجاءَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿رَسُولٌ﴾ a postponed fāʿil; ﴿كَرِيمٌ﴾ an adjective of رسول, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿أَنْ﴾ explicative (tafsīriyya); ﴿أَدُّوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is explicative, with no grammatical position; ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿عِبادَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿رَسُولٌ﴾ the khabar of inna; ﴿أَمِينٌ﴾ an adjective, and the nominal clause is causal.

daas-irab:19-25.t: ﴿وَأَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and أن is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿لا تَعْلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent); ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿آتِيكُمْ﴾ khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl); ﴿بِسُلْطانٍ﴾ both attached to آتيكم; ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿وَإِنِّي﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and inna and its noun; ﴿عُذْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the verbal clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is circumstantial; ﴿بِرَبِّي﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿وَرَبِّكُمْ﴾ conjoined to بربي; ﴿أَنْ تَرْجُمُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by أن, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the dropped first-person yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb عذت; ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and إن is a conditional that makes the verb jussive; ﴿لَمْ﴾ a particle making the verb jussive; ﴿تُؤْمِنُوا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is initial (ibtidāʾiyya); ﴿لِي﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿فَاعْتَزِلُونِ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the nūn is the nūn of protection, and the dropped first-person yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; ﴿فَدَعا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined to an implied clause; ﴿أَنَّ هؤُلاءِ قَوْمٌ﴾ anna, its noun and its khabar; ﴿مُجْرِمُونَ﴾ an adjective of قوم, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and what follows it is in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb دعا; ﴿فَأَسْرِ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition; ﴿بِعِبادِي﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿لَيْلًا﴾ an adverb of time; ﴿إِنَّكُمْ مُتَّبَعُونَ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the nominal clause is a causal explanation; ﴿وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; ﴿رَهْواً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿إِنَّهُمْ جُنْدٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar; ﴿مُغْرَقُونَ﴾ an adjective of جند, and the nominal clause is a causal explanation; ﴿كَمْ﴾ predicative (khabariyya), in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi; ﴿تَرَكُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿مِنْ جَنَّاتٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿وَعُيُونٍ﴾ conjoined to جنات.

daas-irab:26-35.t: ﴿وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقامٍ﴾ both conjoined to جنات; ﴿كَرِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of مقام; ﴿وَنَعْمَةٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to فاكهين; ﴿فاكِهِينَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of كانوا, and the verbal clause is an adjective of نعمة; ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); ﴿وَأَوْرَثْناها﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿قَوْماً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿آخَرِينَ﴾ an adjective; ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and ما is negative; ﴿بَكَتْ﴾ a past verb; ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿السَّماءُ﴾ fāʿil; ﴿وَالْأَرْضُ﴾ conjoined to السماء, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negative; ﴿كانُوا مُنْظَرِينَ﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the response to the oath (jawāb al-qasam), and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); ﴿نَجَّيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿بَنِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ; ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation), and the clause نجينا is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position, and the discourse is resumptive; ﴿مِنَ الْعَذابِ﴾ both attached to نجينا; ﴿الْمُهِينِ﴾ an adjective; ﴿مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ a badal (substitute) for His words من العذاب; ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿كانَ عالِياً﴾ kāna and its khabar, and its noun is latent (mustatir), and the verbal clause is the khabar of inna; ﴿مِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ﴾ both attached to an omitted second khabar, and the nominal clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl); ﴿وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْناهُمْ﴾ see verse no. 30 of the sura; ﴿عَلى عِلْمٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿عَلَى الْعالَمِينَ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿وَآتَيْناهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿مِنَ الْآياتِ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿ما﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿بَلؤُا﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ an adjective of بلاء; ﴿إِنَّ هؤُلاءِ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿لَيَقُولُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿إِنْ﴾ negative; ﴿هِيَ﴾ mubtadaʾ; ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿مَوْتَتُنَا﴾ khabar; ﴿الْأُولى﴾ an adjective, and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, ما is negative, operating like ليس; ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ its noun; ﴿بِمُنْشَرِينَ﴾ genitive in form, accusative in position, as the khabar of ما, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:36-43.t: ﴿فَأْتُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; ﴿بِآبائِنا﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb; ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional that makes the verb jussive; ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the verbal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position; ﴿أَهُمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of interrogation expressing disapproval, and ﴿هُمْ﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction; ﴿قَوْمُ﴾ conjoined to the pronoun; ﴿تُبَّعٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ conjoined to قوم; ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ both attached to an omitted verb forming the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative; ﴿أَهْلَكْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is circumstantial; ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; ﴿مُجْرِمِينَ﴾ its khabar, and the verbal clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl); ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and ما is negative; ﴿خَلَقْنَا السَّماواتِ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined to السموات, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿وَما﴾ conjoined to السموات; ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾ an adverb of place; ﴿لاعِبِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ; ﴿ما﴾ negative; ﴿خَلَقْناهُما﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and lākinna and its noun; ﴿لا﴾ negative; ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the verbal clause is the khabar of lākinna, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl; ﴿إِنَّ يَوْمَ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿الْفَصْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿مِيقاتُهُمْ﴾ its khabar, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis); ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ a badal (substitute) for يوم الفصل; ﴿لا﴾ negative; ﴿يُغْنِي﴾ an imperfect verb; ﴿مَوْلًى﴾ its fāʿil; ﴿عَنْ مَوْلًى﴾ both attached to the verb, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negative; ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ; ﴿يُنْصَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception; ﴿مَنْ﴾ excepted by إلا; ﴿رَحِمَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila of من; ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿هُوَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); ﴿الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ two khabars, and the nominal clause is a causal explanation; ﴿إِنَّ شَجَرَةَ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿الزَّقُّومِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:44-53.t: ﴿طَعامُ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of inna; ﴿الْأَثِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿كَالْمُهْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted second khabar; ﴿يَغْلِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿فِي الْبُطُونِ﴾ both attached to the verb, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿كَغَلْيِ﴾ both attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); ﴿الْحَمِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿خُذُوهُ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the object of an omitted saying (maqūl qawl maḥdhūf); ﴿فَاعْتِلُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿إِلى سَواءِ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿الْجَحِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction; ﴿صُبُّوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; ﴿فَوْقَ﴾ an adverb of place; ﴿رَأْسِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿مِنْ عَذابِ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿الْحَمِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿ذُقْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the object of an omitted saying; ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); ﴿الْعَزِيزُ الْكَرِيمُ﴾ two khabars, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya); ﴿إِنَّ هذا﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿ما﴾ its khabar; ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما; ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to تمترون; ﴿تَمْتَرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause إن هذا is the object of an implied saying; ﴿إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿فِي مَقامٍ﴾ both attached to the omitted khabar of inna; ﴿أَمِينٍ﴾ an adjective; ﴿فِي جَنَّاتٍ﴾ a badal (substitute) for في مقام; ﴿وَعُيُونٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it «[Translator's note: the source text is garbled at this point (the brackets around في جنات and وعيون are corrupted); the reading given here follows the evident intent.]»; ﴿يَلْبَسُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is a second khabar of inna; ﴿مِنْ سُندُسٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted adjective of the omitted object; ﴿وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿مُتَقابِلِينَ﴾ ḥāl.

daas-irab:54-59.t: ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "الأمر كذلك" (the matter is thus); ﴿وَزَوَّجْناهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is conjoined to the clause يلبسون; ﴿بِحُورٍ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿عِينٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ both attached to the verb as well; ﴿فاكِهَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive of annexation); ﴿آمِنِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is circumstantial; ﴿لا يَذُوقُونَ﴾ لا is negative, and an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is circumstantial; ﴿فِيهَا﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿الْمَوْتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception; ﴿الْمَوْتَةَ﴾ excepted; ﴿الْأُولى﴾ an adjective of الموتة; ﴿وَوَقاهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); ﴿عَذابَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿الْجَحِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is circumstantial; ﴿فَضْلًا﴾ an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) «[Translator's note: so in the source; presumably meaning a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb.]»; ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ both attached to فضلا; ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ; ﴿هُوَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); ﴿الْفَوْزُ﴾ the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; ﴿الْعَظِيمُ﴾ an adjective, and the nominal clause ذلك is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and the restraining (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa); ﴿يَسَّرْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive; ﴿بِلِسانِكَ﴾ both attached to the verb; ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ laʿalla and its noun; ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of laʿalla, and the nominal clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl); ﴿فَارْتَقِبْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ inna and its noun; ﴿مُرْتَقِبُونَ﴾ its khabar, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position, and the verbal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position.
